about: Plan C1: the collections whose games go on the PLAY shelf by themselves once they pass the start-up check. Only Bryan adds a line.
rule: Finished games only, and every flagged adult or abusive title kept out of PLAY entirely (Bryan, 20 Nov 2026: "Yes, that rule"; on adult-themed games: "Kept out entirely"); nothing from a collection on Kids; gambling and horror held until he says.
